raw.query: SELECT r.experiment, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.config_c IS NOT NULL) AS n_with_c, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.config_c IS NULL) AS n_without_c, COUNT(DISTINCT r.tp) FILTER (WHERE r.config_c IS NULL) AS distinct_tp_null_c FROM provenance.runs r WHERE r.is_current = TRUE AND r.pool = 'language' GROUP BY r.experiment ORDER BY r.experiment
raw.observed: grid (offline): 93/93 config_c populated (2,4,6,7,8,16,32) — C-budget cap set. live: 0/10 config_c populated; tp=2 on all — no C cap, divide by GPUs-per-replica. live_arm live_fc max_n_live=4 = 8 GPUs / 2 tp.
raw.claimed: Budget units differ between paths: offline caps replicas, live caps divide by GPUs-per-replica.
raw.evidence: Grid experiment (offline budget sweep) is the only experiment using config_c — a C-budget cap in worker/replica units. Live experiment has config_c=null and tp=2 (GPUs-per-replica); live_arm confirms max_n_live=4 = 8 GPUs / 2 tp.
